'''2000 BayCon tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG convention held in DoubleTree Hotel, San Jose, CA on 27 May 2000. [[Clayton Atkin]] won it. It is known from Clayton Atkin's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d829">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-06-04-baycon-2000-5-27d829/ baycon-2000-5-27], DeckTech (Clayton "TheDohMan" Atkin, 4 June 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-06-04-baycon-2000-5-27d829/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 27 May 2000
* '''Site:''' DoubleTree Hotel, San Jose, CA
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Players:''' 20
* '''Winner:''' [[Clayton Atkin]]
